findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quote · Public sink: list_sets, plan_boxes, clarify_request, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quote · Public sink: list_sets, plan_boxes, clarify_request, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
